hooks.title: Event Hooks
hooks.intro: A macro for an event runs by itself when it happens: no script of yours has to keep running. It is told the event in A_Args[1] and the document or PDF in A_Args[2], and works on this window through Doc. BeforeSave and Closing wait for their macro (up to 15 seconds), so it can change the document first. Untick On to keep a macro chosen without it running.
hooks.onTip: Ticked: the macro runs on the event. Unticked: it stays chosen, and doesn't run (Run now still tries it).
hooks.eventStarted: dAHKxodus has started, with its first document (A_Args[2]: its file, if it has one)

hooks.eventBeforeSave: A document is about to be saved: dAHKxodus waits for the macro (A_Args[2]: the file; empty before its first save)
hooks.eventSaved: A document was saved (A_Args[2]: its file)
hooks.eventPdfExported: A PDF was exported (A_Args[2]: the PDF)

rbuttons.title: Ribbon Buttons
rbuttons.intro: Your own buttons, in My buttons on the Macros tab: each runs a macro. Choose a macro, give the button a label, and Add it; select a button to change, remove or move it.

page.hint: Click any paragraph, heading, table cell, footnote, header or footer to edit it. Enter splits a block, Backspace at the start merges it into the previous one, Ctrl+Z undoes. Select text and press New Comment to annotate it. Only the block you changed re-renders — everything else keeps full fidelity, and Save writes a lossless .docx.
